policy.title: GPU policy
items: Every card has a standing owner (see Card assignment). Use your own cards freely.
To use someone else's card, you need the owner's consent first.
When your project ends, you are responsible for backing up and cleaning up your own data.
If a deadline is near and you need more resources, talk to the resource owner at least one week in advance and get Prof. Wang's approval before using them.

penalty.title: Penalties
items: A job running on a card you neither own nor were given may be killed without notice.
Using someone else's GPU without their consent: you lose access to all GPUs, including your own, for the same length of time.

chat.label: WeChat group
chat.emphasis: Communicate first to get more GPU resources.
